generatedFrom.note: This is an offline reconciliation of the existing captured inventory with current source-confirmed repair status. It is not a fresh runtime census.

functionalTests.mode: Source owner functions/registrations with disposable Storage, mocked UI effects and intercepted Trakt API; no live credentials or writes.

previouslyFixedFindings.evidence: The earlier source-confirmed Back self-loop was fixed in merged PR #99 and its isolated regression remains in tests/settings-nc-info.cjs.
previouslyFixedFindings.status: Already fixed on baseline; runtime and TV remain unverified.

followUpQueue.reason: Playback routing controls are captured but their effects and device fallback behavior have no acceptance evidence.
Missing-token auth rendering was exercised without network access; authenticated action and destructive full-reset semantics still need isolated coverage.
The Trakt+ preferences and cache reset run against mocked services; core sync action and account-isolation semantics remain unverified.

followUpQueue.owner: BWA external plugin; owner unresolved in capture
followUpQueue.reason: Ten controls have no attributable source/handler; resolve delivery and owner before claiming support or changing them.
Mocks cover lifecycle/focus and fallback; verify exact delivered assets in one existing browser session when safe access permits.
Four related margin controls share owner-reported storage access; inspect key-level writes and reset semantics in an isolated fixture.
Appearance is the largest category; verify representative high-impact controls against the merged single presentation owner boundaries.
Installation, enable/disable and missing-plugin fallback must be isolated from real user plugin configuration.
Anonymous repeated registrations prevent stable per-control identity; determine whether they are duplicate controls or intentional per-item handlers.
The self-Back defect is fixed, while the owner template remains lazy and represented as a dependency gap until opened through its native owner.
The inventory has no per-control reset, restart or profile-scope certification; derive boundaries from owner code before any migration.
Review visual override candidates using existing ownership and compatibility evidence; the category flag alone is not a confirmed CSS conflict.
